jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.location: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
jobs.description:
What We're About

Apiiro is the Agentic AppSec Platform built to transform how development teams design, develop, and deliver secure software. Powered by Deep Code Analysis, we give security and engineering teams the risk context they need to ship fast without cutting corners. As pioneers in ASPM, we're not just keeping up with the AI era. We're defining what secure development looks like inside it.

About the Team

Our Product team owns the strategy, roadmap, and execution of Apiiro's platform capabilities. We work at the intersection of customer insight, engineering, and go-to-market- translating complex security challenges into clear, high-impact product experiences. This role exists to drive a critical product area as we scale our ASPM platform in the AI era.

What You Will Do

- Own the end-to-end product development lifecycle for your domain, from vision and strategy through roadmap, backlog, and release.

- Translate vision into detailed product strategy and a development backlog that engineering can execute against.

- Lead the product release cycle: identify bottlenecks proactively, coordinate cross-functional dependencies, and raise flags early.

- Connect with customers and internal stakeholders to build deep market understanding and surface requirements.

- Define the metrics and KPIs that measure the health and success of your product area.

What You're About

- 5+ years as a Product Manager on security or developer-focused products.

- Ability to break down complex technical concepts into clear, precise user experiences.

- Strong communicator who thrives working daily with engineers, designers, and marketing in a technically-oriented team.

- Deep understanding of the full product lifecycle: strategy, roadmap, requirements, UI/UX, development, and release.

- Detail-oriented with strong leadership skills and a bias for getting things done.

- Engineering background or strong technical foundation (preferred) .

- Experience with Application Security products (a plus) .

What We Stand For at Apiiro

Customer-First. Our customers are partners, not just clients. We anticipate their needs, go above and beyond to prove business outcomes, and measure our success by theirs.

Excellence Mindset. We set the bar high, embrace challenges with curiosity, and never settle. Good enough isn't in our vocabulary.

OneTeam. One mission, collective ownership, no silos. Our strength is in how we show up for each other and for our customers.

Accountability. We own our actions, our commitments, and our results. Integrity and follow-through are built-in.

Most companies react to security. We believe it should be built in from the start. If that mission resonates, let's talk.
